subject: Mutual action plan and sprint lanes — Northstar Health implementation
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Anika Shah <anika@northstarhealth.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Mutual action plan and sprint lanes — Northstar Health implementation

Hi Anika —

Great to meet earlier this week. Per our call, attached is the first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that lays out the recommended sprint lanes for the initial integration, milestone dates, and owner assignments. The intention here is to provide a tight 10-week path to a production pilot while keeping small, testable deliveries to limit risk.

High level items in this version:
- Sprint lanes: Integration & data plumbing, Model selection & validation, Security review & compliance, Cutover & verification.
- Owners: Redwood SE for model/ops support, Northstar Dev Platform for infra tasks, Northstar ML for validation, Redwood CS for go-live readiness.
- Critical milestones: Infra readiness (Dec 15), Model validation complete (Jan 8), Pilot go-live (Jan 29).
- Contingency windows: Two-week buffer between validation and pilot for QA and rollout adjustments.

Action items for this week:
1) Please confirm infra owner and any blackout dates for December.
2) Procurement: if there are contract milestones your procurement team needs to lock, flag here so we can align.
3) Let me know preferred times for a 30-min handoff + kickoff with our CS and SE teams (proposal: Mon Dec 6 or Tue Dec 7).

Attachment: Northstar_MAP_v1.xlsx (master MAP, milestone sheets + owner roster)

Thanks — happy to walk through live.

— Marcus Lin
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marcus@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0187

From: Anika Shah <anika@northstarhealth.com>

Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 11:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan and sprint lanes — Northstar Health implementation

Marcus —

Thanks for the MAP. This looks like a solid starting point. A few quick notes from our side:

- Infra owner: assigning to Dev Platform (cc'd). They are heads down on a data-migration blackout Dec 20–31. We need to avoid any infra-critical tasks in that window.
- Procurement: we'll likely need a signed SOW before Dec 10 to start any provisioning in December — procurement team, can you confirm?
- Validation: ML team prefers a two-week validation window (we may need to push the model validation completion to Jan 15 instead of Jan 8).

Can we push the pilot target to Feb 5 to account for validation? We'll be available for a kickoff on Tue Dec 7 at 11:00am PT.

-Anika Shah
Head of ML Ops | Northstar Health
anika@northstarhealth.com

FYI: Northstar wants to slide model validation two weeks and push pilot to Feb 5. Key constraints: data-migration blackout Dec 20–31 and procurement wants the SOW signed before Dec 10 to start provisioning.

Can Ben confirm SE availability for these windows and whether the infra tasks proposed (VPC peering, KMS key exchange, restricted egress ACLs) are feasible before Dec 15 if procurement signs on time? Marissa — can you own the kickoff and post-sign SOW handoff? I'd like a short playbook for the handoff and the bridge call.

Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Anika Shah <anika@northstarhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 10:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Mutual action plan and sprint lanes — Northstar Health implementation

Marcus / Marissa —

I reviewed the MAP and the infra asks. Quick callouts:

- SE availability: I can support the Dec 6–8 window for kickoff and the weeks of Dec 13 and Jan 4–15. I will assign a primary and backup SE (primary: ben_carter, backup: jordan_blake).
- Infra feasibility: VPC peering + KMS exchange can be done prior to Dec 15 provided we get network configs from Dev Platform by Dec 3. If procurement cannot meet Dec 10 SOW, we should plan a compressed provisioning sprint in early January.
- Security evidence: Northstar asked about SOC 2 and audit logs. I recommend we surface our SOC 2 Type II report and a short audit-log export sample in the kickoff packet. Legal may require a standard Data Processing Addendum (DPA) signed as part of SOW.

Proposed adjustments to the MAP (summary):
1) Move "Model validation complete" to Jan 15 (aligns with Anika).
2) Add a "Provisioning window" Dec 6–15 with a hard freeze Dec 20–31.
3) Pilot go-live target Feb 5 with a 1-week canary period (Feb 5–12) then scale.

I attached a short checklist to use during SOW acceptance and the CS handoff.

— Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

2) Kickoff: Tue Dec 7 11:00am PT — agenda below. Invite will go out once Marcus confirms.

Kickoff agenda (30 min):
- Introductions & objectives (5m)
- MAP walkthrough (10m)
- Infra pre-reqs & data handoff (5m)
- Security artifacts & SOW milestones (5m)
- Next steps & owners (5m)

I’ll run a 45-minute handoff workshop the week after SOW for the detailed runbook. I’ve attached the Handoff_Checklist_v2.pdf for reference and will build the runbook from that.

Also tagging legal: we may need the DPA + SLA exception for the pilot window—Marcus, can you surface any SLA exceptions the procurement team has requested? I’ve flagged a potential exception to our standard 99.9% latency SLO during canary to avoid escalations; Ben noted the SLA-exception-request.pdf as a template.
